Definition: a Shelanite (collectively), or descendants of Shelah
BiblicalUsage: The Shelanites are the family of Shelah, counted among the sons of Judah in the wilderness: of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites. The family takes its name from the man, and the man takes his place in the tribe.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe families are how God keeps His promises. The Shelanites are counted because Shelah was counted, and I hold that belonging to God's people is a family matter.
